confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are triangulated from web-search result summaries (price-comparison pages such as Expatistan and a Feb 2026 city guide); no individual pages were opened. Beer, cappuccino and cocktail sources broadly agree (apart from a lower outlier on beer). The inexpensive meal is reasonably supported. The two-person mid-range meal varied by about 30% across sources and a bottom-up check, so a bounded middle value was used. No clear per-glass restaurant wine index was found, so wine rests on a guide's house-wine range nudged up for restaurants and a roughly 1.05x relationship to beer. Cocktail was also sense-checked at roughly 1.6x beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge for a July winter/school-holiday window (no accommodation searches or booking pages inspected) and are the least certain. FX is the RBA 4 pm AUD/USD observation for 2026-11-18 as reported in the search result.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink use Melbourne-specific price-index and guide data. Sydney is the closest comparable Australian city (one guide put Sydney pints slightly above Melbourne), and accommodation was positioned a little below Sydney-level big-city pricing.
